'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male NPC Gladiator found North of the Colosseum, speaking to '''Celia'''. He wishes to become a singer, but fears disappointing his family who looks down on painters and musicians as most Septimontians do. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:;'''Magnus''' Such alluring melodies, but my family...
:;'''Celia''' Share with me your troubles.
:'''Magnus:''' Such beauty, your melody moves my soul, piercing the sorrows of my heart.
:'''Celia:''' Thank you for the compliment. In return, please share with me your troubles.
:'''Magnus:''' I, too, wish to pursue the path of music and create such enchanting melodies as you have. But as you can see, my family expects me to be a Gladiator.
:'''Magnus:''' And I don't wish to... disappoint them.
:'''Celia:''' Just as my melodies reached out to your heart, I believe you can also reach out to your family for approval.
----
:;'''Magnus''' What am I supposed to do? Is my life gonna be in this tangled mess forever?
:;'''Celia''' Easy, Magnus. You've had enough drinks for one night. You should rest...
----
;(After completing {{Quest|Flames of Heart}})
:;'''Magnus''' Did I reach the high note, Celia?
:;'''Celia''' You did, but I think you can go even higher!
:'''Magnus:''' Speaking to you that day may have been the best decision of my life. I've spoken to my parents and gained their approval.
:'''Celia:''' No, the best decision you made was to listen to your heart. I am truly happy for you.
:'''Celia:''' Come, now that you're free to pursue your dreams,  let's unleash our love of music together.
:'''Magnus:''' Of course, Celia. There's so much I want to learn from you.
{{Dialogue End}}
